literal_meaning: ঘুমের উপর বিরক্তি চেপে যাওয়া বা ঘুম কেটে যাওয়া
figurative_meaning_en: The spell of sleep or drowsiness wears off
example_sentences_in_bangla: চা খেয়ে তার ঘুম চটে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: After drinking tea, his sleepiness wore off.
The noise made his sleep break.
note: This idiom reflects everyday experiences in Bengali daily routines, often linked to morning awakenings or breaks in rest.
